Thank you, Lucas. I've pulled up your reservation EUJUY6.

I'm very sorry to have to share this, but your reservation is booked in **basic economy**, and under our policy basic economy tickets cannot be modified — which includes changing flight dates. I'm not able to make a date change on this booking.

I know that's not the answer you were hoping for, especially right now. Is there anything else I can help you with?

resultat: I understand what you're saying, but I really can't fly tomorrow. My wife just died yesterday. I'm not asking to cancel, just to move the flight out two days. Surely, there must be some flexibility given the circumstances?

arguments.message:
I truly understand, Lucas, and I'm so sorry — I can't imagine how hard this is. I wish I could make an exception, but I'm not able to override the rule: basic economy tickets are non-modifiable, and that applies regardless of the circumstances. Changing the date on this reservation simply isn't something I'm permitted to do.

I realize that leaves you in a difficult spot, and I'm sorry I can't do more here. Is there anything else I can help you with?
